_example_note: Demonstration artifact. Derived from the M4-01 runtime contract example (contracts/examples/runtime-contract.example.json) by applying the M4-02 projection rules and the M32-01 safe options projection. Domain bounds (min, max) have been stripped. Rendering hints (label, input_type, optional, display_order) have been added. A categorical feature's raw domain_constraints.values list is never copied verbatim; only a safe {value, label} options projection is added, sourced from those values. Does not represent a specific real dataset.
